::: {#thm-sq-bias-expand}
#### Expanded squared bias

For any one-dimensional estimator $\hparam$ of an estimand $\param$,
the squared [bias](#def-bias) is:

$$\sqf{\bias{\hparam}} = \sqf{\E{\hparam}} - 2\E{\hparam}\param + \param^2$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-sq-bias-expand, worked in @sol-sq-bias-expand.

:::
